sample_policy: Latest publicly accessible, content-verified report found per included broker on or before the cutoff. This is a three-report comparison sample, not the full sell-side consensus.
coverage_limit: Three verified public reports only. It does not establish that no other or newer broker research existed before the cutoff. The LS document is an author-identifiable full-report mirror rather than a broker-hosted copy.
